segments.t: Echeveria 'Alba Aloha' 翻译：Qiuhan Parentage : Echeveria tolimanensis x E. subcorymbosa Lau 030 亲本：拟石莲属杜里万莲 x 拟石莲属蓝宝石Lau 030 Created by Brian McDonough 由Brian McDonough培育 Brian explains the name as follows : Brian对这个名字的解释如下： "The Alba in this instance is not a reference to a white colour, but to the Gaelic name for Scotland. The Aloha came as a result of the flowers. The wavy, horizontal disposition of the flowering stem reminded me of the arm movements of Hawaiian dancers. Hence 'Alba Aloha' - A Scottish Hello !" “这里的Alba（意为‘白’）并不是指颜色，而是盖尔语中苏格兰的意思。Aloha（夏威夷语的词汇，代表希望、爱、和平、幸福等）则是指花的形态，那种水平伸展的波浪状花梗让我不禁想起夏威夷舞者舞动的手臂。因此，'Alba Aloha'可以理解为——来自苏格兰的祝福。”
